title: Spicy Korean Naengmyeon with Egg
description: A spicy twist on the classic Korean cold noodle dish, featuring a fried egg and crunchy naengmyeon.
instructions: Cook the naengmyeon according to package instructions.
Fry the eggs in a pan over medium heat until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to desired doneness.
Combine the cooked naengmyeon, zesty sauce, and salty broth in a large bowl.
Add the fried eggs on top of the naengmyeon mixture.
Garnish with sesame seeds and chopped green onions, if desired.
